messages:
marta: Heads-up from southamerica-provision job: several GPU nodes failed to finish bootstrap after we flipped the peering egress policy. Kubelet shows KMS decrypt timeouts and the audit-shipper is spiking. Anyone else seeing this?

diego: seeing it in sa-east-1a. 10 nodes in warmpool stuck in `booting` for 2-3m then failed. Logs show repeated 504 from audit-exporter and then KMS decrypt timeouts.

rachel: likely path: peering rule tightened to block 198.51.100.0/24 (legacy SIEM collector). Our audit-shipper sends logs there and when it fails it retries fast -> NAT conntrack saturation -> other egress calls (KMS/HSM) get delayed or reset.

marta: sample tail from one node: ```
[2026-03-23T09:04:12Z] audit-shipper: POST https://siem.example.net/events -> 504
[2026-03-23T09:04:14Z] keystore-proxy: POST /decrypt -> timeout
[2026-03-23T09:04:15Z] kubelet: node join failed: decrypt timeout
```

priya: impact: ~12 GPUs delayed, autoscaler trimmed some batch slots causing job backfills. This looks like a policy mis-scope in the new VPC peering egress. Quick mitigation: allowlist audit-target CIDR for peering route while we fix retry behaviour.

diego: agree. Also we should add backpressure gating to audit-shipper so it doesn't retry aggressively when remote is unreachable. That will avoid conntrack blowouts.

marta: ops-bot, please create a temp CR to open peering egress to 198.51.100.0/24 in sa-east-1 for 2h and attach runbook. Approvers: @priya, @diego.

ops-bot: Created CR-2026-700: "sa-east-1 peering egress allow: 198.51.100.0/24 (temp)". Approvers: @priya, @diego. Auto-expire: 2h. Runbook attached.

priya: approved. Applying now. Monitoring node join rate and NAT conntrack metrics.

rachel: short-term metrics improving: conntrack used dropped from 89%->32% in 90s, join failures decreasing. Good signal.

diego: medium-term actions: (1) add retry-backoff+jitter to audit-shipper (P0), (2) add preflight peering test that exercises audit endpoints before flipping rules (P0), (3) inventory all SIEM endpoints referenced in peering rules and centralize into allowlist (P1).

marta: also flagging cost impact: retry storm added ~2.7GB egress to peering and extra NAT hours while nodes looped; preliminary estimate $25. We'll quantify in PM.

priya: opened PM-2026-811. Actions listed and owner assignments. Reminder: when changing peering/egress rules, include control-plane and audit collectors in the preflight.

marta: thanks all. I'll monitor for the next 30m and close if stable. :thumbsup:
